title: Anion Gap
sources: Standard clinical chemistry; Emmett M, Narins RG. Medicine (Baltimore) 1977

changelog.change: Initial entry. Stable formula — no scheduled review.

purpose: First step in any metabolic acidosis workup. Albumin-correct when albumin is low.

interpretation.label: Normal anion gap (≈ 6-11 mmol/L, K+ not included)
High anion gap metabolic acidosis — pursue GOLD-MARK / MUDPILES differential

notes: Reference range assumes K+ is not included in the calculation. Correction adds ~2.5 mmol/L per 1 g/dL the albumin is below 4.
buildNote: Stable math — review_tier 'stable', so the staleness tripwire ignores it. Leave albumin blank to suppress the corrected result in the UI.
